Capture: an enemy can be captured once its HP is at or below this percent of its maximum. Bosses cannot be captured.
Ransom: extra gold per enemy captured rather than defeated (a defeat is worth income_per_kill, so mercy pays better but drops no weapon).
Shove (map action): tiles an adjacent unit is pushed straight away from the shover. Gunnar starts with this; it upgrades to Smite once he is certified.
Smite (map action): the same push, one tile further. A class with 'smite' in classes.map_actions (the Housecarl) has it from the start; a shove unit gains it on certification.
Tiles an armor-movement target resists a Shove/Smite (so a plain Shove cannot move armor at all, a Smite moves it one). Bosses are never pushed.

Shove/Smite collision: a pushed unit that hits a wall, the map edge or another unit takes this percent of its own max HP (rounded down); a unit it hits takes the same of its own. Never lethal: it stops at 1 HP.
Bribe (Kheldar's map action): gold base price to turn an adjacent enemy neutral for the rest of the map.
Bribe: extra gold per level of the enemy (a level-5 levy costs 90, a level-10 billman 140).
Bribe: how many enemies Kheldar can turn per map (canon: 'bribe one enemy to neutral'). Bosses cannot be bribed.
